officials.name: Becky Tuttle
officials.address: Wichita City Hall 455 N Main Wichita, KS 67202
officials.hours: 8am to 5pm Monday to Friday CLOSED Saturday and Sunday
officials.bio: Becky Pattison Tuttle has over thirty years of professional experience engaging community partners. She was appointed in 2019 and twice elected as the City of Wichita District 2 Council Member, representing approximately 70,000 residents. Along with other council members and the Mayor, she provides direct supervision to the City Manager and oversight to 18 departments.

officials.name: Dalton Glasscock
officials.address: Wichita City Hall 455 N Main Wichita, KS 67202
officials.hours: 8am to 5pm Monday to Friday CLOSED Saturday and Sunday
officials.bio: Dalton Glasscock was elected as the council member for District 4 on November 7, 2023. He serves as the chief executive officer of a national media company and also owns a consulting firm, having previously worked for the U.S. House of Representatives. Glasscock has a Master of Arts in Education and Human Development and has served the community in various capacities, including on the Sedgwick County Commission.

officials.name: J.V. Johnston
officials.address: Wichita City Hall 455 N Main Wichita, KS 67202
officials.hours: 8am to 5pm Monday to Friday CLOSED Saturday and Sunday
officials.bio: J.V. Johnston was elected as the District 5 Council Member in 2023. He previously served as President/Owner of Johnston's Clothiers and Executive Director at Guadalupe Clinic. His priorities include addressing the homelessness crisis and improving relationships with the Wichita Police Department and first responders.

officials.name: Joseph Shepard
officials.address: Wichita City Hall 455 N Main Wichita, KS 67202
officials.bio: Joseph Shepard was elected to the Wichita City Council in November 2025 with a demonstrated commitment to public service, community advocacy, and advancing opportunity for all residents. Since taking office, he has focused on transparent governance, strategic neighborhood investment, and policies that support families, small businesses, and workforce development across the City of Wichita.

officials.name: Maggie Ballard
officials.address: Wichita City Hall 455 N Main Wichita, KS 67202
officials.hours: 8am to 5pm Monday to Friday CLOSED Saturday and Sunday
officials.bio: Maggie Ballard was elected to serve as the District 6 council member in November 2021 and sworn in on January 10, 2022. Born and raised in Wichita, she is a local business owner and founder of Paxton's Blessing Box, a nonprofit addressing food insecurity. Before her election, she was active in various community organizations.

officials.name: Mike Hoheisel
officials.address: Wichita City Hall 455 N Main Wichita, KS 67202
officials.hours: 8am to 5pm Monday to Friday CLOSED Saturday and Sunday
officials.bio: Mike Hoheisel was elected District III council member in November 2021. A Wichita resident for over 30 years, he has been active in civic activities and the construction industry for 20+ years. He is a graduate of West High, attended Wichita State and Fort Hays State, and actively volunteers coaching youth sports.

officials.name: Lily Wu
officials.address: Wichita City Hall 455 N Main Wichita, KS 67202
officials.hours: 8am to 5pm Monday to Friday CLOSED Saturday and Sunday
officials.bio: Mayor Lily Wu was sworn in as Wichita’s 103rd mayor in January 2024. Mayor Lily is the first woman elected to a full term in the largest city in Kansas. She is also the first Asian American mayor in the state’s history. She has been a Wichitan since 1993, when her family immigrated to Wichita from Guatemala. Mayor Lily was an award-winning local television journalist and is a proud alumna of Wichita Public Schools, including Wichita High School East, Wichita State University, and the University of Hong Kong. As mayor, she champions a vision focused on ensuring public safety, strengthening the economy, restoring trust in City Hall, and building a united community.
